title: Propagate #creationId blobId resolution to filenode, scene, chat, contacts, calendars
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B21. Crates: jmap-filenode-server, jmap-scene-server, jmap-chat-server, jmap-contacts-server, jmap-calendars-server. Size: M.

Mirror B20's canonical change (docs/design/blobext.md §9 'Existing crates') in every sibling server that accepts a blobId: FileNode/set blobId, scene asset/object blob properties, chat attachment blobIds, contacts and calendars blobId-typed properties (card media, event attachments). Use resolve_creation_ref exactly as mail-server does. Acceptance: per crate a test where an earlier createdIds entry supplies #c1 and the /set succeeds; unknown #ref keeps the existing error; no divergence from the mail-server idiom.
